title: Profile: Michael Funk, Superintendent of Stillwater Area Public Schools
summary:
This midweek profile introduces Dr. Michael "Mike" Funk, superintendent of Stillwater Area Public Schools since July 2022 — the appointed chief executive who runs the roughly-8,000-student district serving Stillwater, Oak Park Heights, Bayport, Lake Elmo, and communities along the St. Croix. A factual portrait from the public record and his own words: his path from a high-school classroom through 30 years in the Army National Guard (he retired a colonel in 2018) and a long run as Albert Lea's superintendent, to being named 2022 Minnesota Superintendent of the Year and hired unanimously by the Stillwater board; the office of superintendent and how he holds it; the district's finances, including the roughly $5 million gap it worked to close for 2025-26; and his stated leadership beliefs and his November 2025 statement on student safety, all quoted verbatim.

Sources (public record): Stillwater Area Public Schools official site — Superintendent page, "Board selects Dr. Funk as district's next superintendent" (selected unanimously Apr. 8, 2022; start July 1, 2022; Board Chair Alison Sherman quote), "New superintendent is ready to lead" (Funk's three core beliefs and staff message, verbatim), the Nov. 12, 2025 "Statement from Superintendent Mike Funk" (student-safety safeguards, verbatim), and "District To Close $5 Million Budget Gap for 2025-26" (gap size, ~3% of operating budget, READ Act ~$800K); First Student Superintendent-of-the-Year profile (education, career, military); Patch and St. Croix Valley Magazine (Albert Lea record; "Expect the best" quote); Minnesota Association of School Administrators 2022 Superintendent of the Year; Wikipedia (district size/geography). Meeting records are the Stillwater-area district's BoardBook portal (organization 2592).
